svg.title: About a minute from approval to proof, nearly all of it the witness
svg.text: About a minute from approval to proof. Nearly all of it is the witness.
63.4 s from the policy event, 62.9 s from approval
two verdicts: the paired probes, the enumerating witness, the service recreated, both again
the witness: 21 to 31 s per verdict; each paired probe about one second
the price of not trusting a sample
with a person approving through the page: 69.4 s and 65.6 s; a later change read 55.6 s on the ledger's clock
and no more than 55.6 s on the signing service's; a starting figure for one listener on one estate, not a benchmark
